prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- home: 86.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Guide Screen: Adds a dedicated quick-guide screen after home intro showing mouse and keyboard shortcuts for controlling, hiding, and talking to the desktop pet. (why: Support received 3 complaints from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding completes.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Overlay Display Diagnostic Flow: Adds a screen rendering verification flow at the end of setup that runs a desktop overlay check to verify pet visibility on screen. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet failed to display on the desktop or the app failed to launch properly after setup.)
2: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Render Quality Hint: Displays explicit photo quality tips directly on the upload screen to prevent bad render outputs. (why: 3 support emails noted custom pet generation failing or producing corrupted pet visuals, and adoption step drop-off is 32% (68.0% conversion).)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Personality Carousel During Wait: Adds a rotating tip carousel on the waiting screen highlighting pet personality traits and animation previews while waiting. (why: The waiting screen has a mean duration of 2336s and 14% drop-off; engaging content reduces perceived wait time.)
4: [home, notification] System Desktop Ready Notification Prompt: Enables system notifications on the waiting screen to alert the user when pet rendering completes if they switch windows. (why: The waiting screen (target_step home) takes a median 201s and mean 2336s, causing users to switch away and abandon the desktop pet app.)
5: [finish, layout] Pet Interaction Checklist Welcome Layout: Changes the home intro screen layout to a structured checklist guiding users through their first 3 desktop pet actions. (why: 64.8% completion rate at the final step and support emails asking how to control, summon, or hide the pet.)
